Bonus notice lifecycle: one read in force at a time (a newer read supersedes an older), unparsable expiry is not expiry, doubling acknowledgement backoff that never outlives the session, and a seen card survives an empty read.
Preopens a blank tab during the user's click, nulls opener, navigates once when the authorize URL arrives, and closes the tab on failure, expiry or cancellation.
Per-call client identity (build version, UI language, UTC offset in seconds east); a build with no DSH_CLIENT_VERSION throws.
Builds the questionnaire URL: hide_/prefill_ pairs for uid, source, harness_version and device_info, and deletes the six unsupported fields' parameters.
The full onboarding visual system: Figma-positioned artwork, credit and card grids, animated conic-gradient selection border, brand font weights, darwin drag clearance and four breakpoints.
Onboarding flow coordinator: four pages, a 40ms fade transition that tolerates cancellation, once-per-page analytics events, the shared recharge request and the two skip confirmations.
Framework-hook projection into the onboarding view; retains the last page for a 180ms exit, and removes it immediately under reduced motion.
Platform Web currency formatting on big.js: truncated cents, <0.01 for positive sub-cent, negative amounts with a 0.01 minimum magnitude.

Account plugin browser half: shared snapshot, account stream, generation-fenced profile/balance reads, bonus controller, shared Platform channel, Desktop onboarding controller and every slot registration.

Inline Figma logout glyph (decorative, aria-hidden) for theme-aware rendering.
FLIP-style card promotion: measure survivors, cancel animations, flushSync the dismissal, then animate each survivor from its old rectangle over 250ms.
hasOnboardingCredit counts purchased and granted wallets and does not treat a pending query as zero.
Pure view inputs of the onboarding flow: DesktopOnboardingState, OnboardingChange and DesktopOnboardingProps.
Reads API-key presence through the boolean-only dshOnboarding bridge; a missing bridge or failed read rejects rather than reporting absent.

Resumable onboarding controller: verifies saved values rather than just acceptance, re-checks the account status around each write, freezes creditFunded at first entry, and retries exactly the failed step.
The two skip/credit confirmations as focus-contained headless Modals with backdropBlur disabled.
Credit page whose action ordering is fixed at first entry and whose buttons are disabled in the impossible states.
Two independently selectable work-purpose cards combining into a both value; descriptions never change on select/deselect.
Renders the light and dark artwork as two images, with the CSS theme selector deciding which is visible.
Work-detail radio group with roving focus: arrows move selection and focus together and wrap around.
Overlay surface, 180ms exit animation, darwin transparency, and the -webkit-app-region rules that clear the inherited no-drag and keep an 8px native resize margin.
Body-portaled onboarding stage that makes #root inert and transparent for its lifetime and restores the previous inline opacity.
Welcome page with a required explicit Get started and the en/zh, light/dark illustration pair.
Ref-counted inert ownership in a WeakMap; restores the element's original inert value only when the last owner releases, and the release is idempotent.
Shared native Platform page channel: a newer request installs itself before retiring the previous owner, and the release is token-guarded so a stale owner cannot close the replacement.
Full-window native overlay, the Windows caption clearance token, the darwin traffic-light spacer, the 48px return bar and an embedded base64 spinner.
Desktop native Platform viewport; inertness and focus are restored in the layout cleanup so a Modal mounted in the same commit records the restored focus first.
Headless dialog geometry, right-aligned action row, underline link treatment and the reduced-motion spinner.
Authorization dialog: copyable link with a 2s label restore, clipboard failure that does not interrupt sign-in, and network copy shown only for the no-response error code.
Sign-out confirmation with idle/running/unknown impact copy; a failure keeps the dialog open for retry.
Public questionnaire options and the two bonus-acknowledgement retry timings, with an HTTPS-only schema pattern for the form URL.

Host half: combines the public contact config with the volatile onboarding fields and publishes the contact options into the page bootstrap via webserver/index-inject.
The ui-settings-account namespace: onboarding progress fields with explicitly nullable unsaved choices and a format version.
Shared image load: pending/successful loads are shared, failures retried only on request, replaced and disposed callbacks discarded, superseded failure reports ignored.
Post-return ordering: the new query starts after the pre-return one settles and a failed pre-return query does not block it.

Account UI: no invented profile/balance data, sign-in and cancel states, the sign-out impact matrix, themed authorization link, balance formatting, one-read-per-Settings-entry and the notice reporting its display once.

Account plugin in the shipped composition: browser vs Desktop sign-in, the quota claim, the questionnaire prefill rules, the shared avatar, coalesced and stale-rejected refreshes, the Platform page ownership and the API-key defaults.

Bonus lifecycle in full: activation-only reads, acknowledgement after a presented frame, doubling backoff, session re-entry, abandoned in-flight reads, expired-award suppression and sign-out dropping the pending acknowledgement.
Tab ownership: one navigation, closure on failure/expiry/cancel, the blocked-popup route and a waiting frame that arrived before the initial response.
Client identity: the UTC offset as seconds east, re-sampled per call, and a versionless build refused.
Host half: the contact options injected into the page bootstrap and released on disposal; the settings scope configured with auto false.
Questionnaire URL rules: hide/prefill pairs, percent-encoding, omitted context, HTTPS-only schema, the six unsupported fields dropped, physical resolution rounding.
Entry behaviour: the 180ms exit, the workspace inert until unmount, the loading overlay, notices withheld through exit, and immediate removal on sign-out.

Onboarding pages: mandatory welcome, credit always offering recharge and only confirming a known zero, purpose combining, radio arrow keys, aria-disabled instead of disabled while saving, and once-only analytics.

The credential step claims onboarding while mounted, offers the API-key fallback, completes after login and releases the claim on unmount.
A CSS-text test: jsdom has no layout, so the Windows caption-clearance declaration is asserted by reading the stylesheet.
Shared channel: idle close ignored, owner retired once, stale release cannot clear the replacement, teardown drops without retiring, and a throwing subscriber does not stop the others.

The notice contract: keepOpen() is called before the page request (asserted by invocationCallOrder), the Modal defers while a page shows, the first snapshot is awaited, and the hold is released on sign-out or unmount.
Login dialog: the two choices, timeout requiring explicit retry, cancel-before-dismiss, the committing attempt resisting Escape, the 2s copy-label restore and the no-response-only network copy.
Sign-out impact copy matrix, three dismissal routes, and a failure keeping the dialog open with dismissal blocked while in flight.

Mirror concurrency contract, including a named regression about a load landing between a run settling and its slot clearing.
